question: What forms of reviling Shiva or the Kula Bhairava prohibit transmission of the teaching?
premises: Slandering the Kula Bhairava disqualifies a person
The prohibition is addressed to the goddess
inference: The teaching must not be given to one who reviles Shiva or slanders the Kula Bhairava.
plain_english: O Goddess, not to one who reviles Shiva, nor to one who slanders the Kula Bhairava.
